25/S0.subgoal: Explain how an XR system's interaction and perceptual design aim to create the illusion of reality and why human perception must be understood.

25/S1.subgoal: Explain why VR must override natural perception and how inconsistent artificial stimulation can lead to adaptation or cybersickness, motivating the need to study human perception.

25/S2.subgoal: Define perceptual psychology and identify the design questions and knowledge areas it covers for XR.

25/S3.subgoal: Classify the human senses by their stimuli, receptors, and sense organs.

25/S4.subgoal: Explain sensory system selectivity and how specific receptors detect specific stimuli.

25/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points on perceptual psychology and the six senses covered, and preview the next part on sensing.
